summary: How far HeapReAlloc(HEAP_REALLOC_IN_PLACE_ONLY) grows a process-heap block (Sprint 065; game run 38216081440 seq 3265-3268, where Windows refuses UnityPlayer's growths of a 0x417 block to 0x817 and on, and w2m granted three). Grown one byte at a time, a block of 1 to 0x10000 bytes stops at the larger of its size and 16, fresh or after 40 blocks of its size; the refusal answers NULL with ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY. A 0x417 block whose next block was freed does not grow to 0x817.
applicability: windows-2022 (AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor); windows-2025 (AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor)

initial.process: started by the runner's cmd with standard output redirected

acceptance.derivation: scripts/family_run.py no_steps: The step between two blocks (a limit row's step_forward and step_back, neighbour_freed's b_after_a) is an address relation that differs between runs; it is dropped.

evidence.source_ref: run 38254640218: windows-2025, AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor, probe sha256:5419841125b5d6e9725bc821eb9c8d2d9ff50d992513aaeeaafd5ff596c3d1fb; run 38254643501: windows-2022, AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor, probe sha256:e8a6346e7051fd4f169b7aaddb5c8e7231f59e91e933ca96888e4887e2aba2e9

evidence.quote: HEAP_REALLOC_IN_PLACE_ONLY ... There can be no movement when reallocating a memory block. If this value is not specified, the function may move the block to a new location. If this value is specified and the block cannot be resized without moving, the function fails, leaving the original memory block unchanged.

open_questions: Windows grows a block in place into a free next block (the excluded rows); w2m's heap neither keeps blocks in address order nor joins neighbours, so it refuses where Windows may grant. The game's four growths are refused on Windows.
A block shrunk in place keeps its reach in w2m; no row shows a shrink then a growth in place.

sections.excluded: limit.fresh.1000: the same run grew it to 4,880 bytes, its next block free.; limit.fresh.800: one run of six grew the block to 3,232 bytes: its next block was free (the second block lay before it); w2m's heap does not join free neighbours.; limit.warm.1: after 40 one-byte blocks Windows grows a one-byte block by nothing (its low-fragmentation heap serves the size), a fresh one to 16 bytes; w2m's heap has no low-fragmentation heap and answers 16.
